stock.description: Shanghai Top Numerical Control Technology Co., Ltd., headquartered in Shanghai, China, specializes in the research, development, production, and distribution of intelligent manufacturing equipment. The company provides a comprehensive range of advanced machinery, primarily for the aviation and aerospace industries, encompassing computer numerical control (CNC) process equipment and five-axis CNC machine tools. Its offerings further include compact industrial five-axis machine tools, large-span five-axis machines for carbon fiber composites, and various specialized tools such as dual five-axis mirror milling machines, horizontal flip-type milling five-axis machines, automated drilling and riveting docking equipment, and friction stir welding five-axis machine tools, alongside aerospace five-axis machining centers and assembled products. Additionally, the company delivers repair and maintenance services for CNC machine tools. These sophisticated solutions cater to a wide array of sectors, including aviation, automotive, new energy, medical device manufacturing, shipbuilding, general machine tool production, and die and mold fabrication, as well as general machining processes. The company was founded in 2007.
